method: Doria (National Library of Finland) OAI-PMH Maps set com_10024_109232, combining oai_dc discovery, MODS date/rights and ORE bitstreams; rights-gated and published as a catalogue shard.

selection.rule: Every item in Doria’s documented OAI-PMH Maps set (com_10024_109232) is a candidate. It is imported only when oai_dc type includes map, the Doria/MODS statements carry an explicit Public Domain Mark or CC0 licence URL or an explicit “Public domain” statement, no separate restrictive statement appears in either record, and ORE publishes a thumbnail plus an original bitstream. Titles, creators, publisher, language, URN and the Doria handle are retained verbatim; no date, extent, creator or rights statement is inferred.
selection.metadataReuse: Doria’s catalogue facts are reused with attribution and a link to every original record. The site’s public terms page (https://www.doria.fi/page/terms) was empty at retrieval, so no separate metadata licence URL is claimed; the image rights are the per-item PDM/CC0/public-domain statements recorded on each catalogue entry.
